name: plumbline-mcp
description: Free, read-only Sui DeepBook v3 market data: pools, mid price, order book depth, volume, fees, trades, OHLCV. No keys, no wallet. Education only, not financial advice.
long_description: Plumbline gives AI agents a compact, read-only view of Sui DeepBook v3: pools and trading params, best bid/ask and spread, order book depth within ±X% of mid, 24h/custom volume, live on-chain fees, recent trades, OHLCV candles and data-source health (8 tools). Data comes from the public DeepBook indexer and Sui GraphQL. No API keys, no wallet, no signing or trading. Education/information only; not financial advice.

indexer_url.title: DeepBook indexer URL
indexer_url.description: Optional. Public DeepBook v3 indexer base URL.

graphql_url.title: Sui GraphQL URL
graphql_url.description: Optional. Sui GraphQL endpoint used for live on-chain pool parameters.

timeout_ms.title: Upstream timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: Optional. Per-request timeout for upstream calls, 1000 to 60000.
